title: Sea of Remnants 氪金吗？P2W、角色抽卡、服装抽卡、交易市场与零氪体验 FAQ
titleEn: Is Sea of Remnants Pay-to-Win? Gacha, Outfits, Trade Market, and F2P FAQ
summary: 面向海外玩家的 Sea of Remnants pay-to-win / gacha explained 搜索，解释角色抽卡、服装抽卡、交易市场、免费资源和零氪判断边界。
summaryEn: An English-first FAQ for Sea of Remnants pay-to-win and gacha questions, covering character pulls, outfit gacha, trade market, free rewards, and F2P boundaries.
content:
## Quick Answer

Sea of Remnants has gacha-related monetization, but “pay-to-win” depends on what you mean by winning. The safer answer is: it appears to combine character acquisition, cosmetic/outfit monetization, free launch rewards, and a player trade economy. Do not assume it is purely cosmetic, and do not assume it is impossible to play free-to-play.

For English players, the useful question is not “Is it P2W?” in isolation. Ask: **Are characters locked behind pulls? Are cosmetics separate? Can F2P players clear story and weekly content? Does the trade market create pressure?**

Sources and discussion signals: [Reddit gacha discussion](https://www.reddit.com/r/gachagaming/comments/1qxbgoa/sea_of_remnants_upcoming_sea_adventure_turnbased/), [character gacha showcase discussion](https://www.reddit.com/r/SeaOfRemnants/comments/1tq1n43/sea_of_remnants_character_gacha_showcase/), and our [payment model guide](/en/sea/guides/payment-model-guide).

## Monetization Map

| System | What it means | P2W concern |
|---|---|---|
| Character pulls | Crews may be acquired through Black/Purple Ticket systems | High if power is locked behind rare characters |
| Outfit/cosmetic gacha | Fashion, appearance, or social expression | Lower if cosmetic only |
| Free launch rewards | Selectors, pulls, mail, events | Helps F2P start but may be time-limited |
| Trade market | Good Gold Bricks and player economy | Depends on what can be traded and how pricing works |
| Weekly dredging | Long-term free acquisition path | Reduces pressure if rewards are meaningful |

## How to Judge P2W as a Player

1. Can you clear story without limited characters?
2. Can weekly modes be cleared with free or early selector units?
3. Are the strongest upgrades only from paid pulls?
4. Are cosmetics separated from combat power?
5. Does the trade market let spenders dominate progression materials?
6. Are free selectors and weekly dredging enough to build a stable first team?

## F2P Route

If you want to play free-to-play, use this order:

1. Claim launch rewards and codes first.
2. Understand the Black Ticket 6-selector before choosing.
3. Build one stable team, not every new character.
4. Do weekly Memory Tower/dredging content.
5. Treat outfits as optional unless they include gameplay value.
6. Avoid trade-market speculation until prices stabilize.

## Chinese Quick Notes

如果你搜的是“遗忘之海氪金吗 / 遗忘之海 P2W 吗”，目前最稳的判断是：游戏存在抽取和外观消费，零氪能否舒服取决于免费黑券、周常打捞、交易市场限制和高压内容门槛。先看 [付费模式详解](/zh/sea/guides/payment-model-guide) 和 [黑券 6 选 1 指南](/zh/sea/guides/black-ticket-six-selector-guide)。

## FAQ

### Is Sea of Remnants pay-to-win?

It depends on the final live economy and endgame pressure. Treat it as a gacha game with potential power and cosmetic monetization, then judge by whether F2P teams can clear meaningful weekly content.

### Does Sea of Remnants have character gacha?

Public discussions and launch coverage point to character acquisition through ticket-style systems. Exact rates, pity, and banner rules should be checked in-game.

### Can F2P players enjoy Sea of Remnants?

Likely yes for story, exploration, and casual progression if you plan resources carefully. Competitive or high-pressure content may depend more on team strength and long-term acquisition.
